solution:
Write \(3x+4 = A\frac{d}{dx}(x^2+6x+5)+B = A(2x+6)+B\).
Comparing coefficients: \(2A=3,\ 6A+B=4\Rightarrow A=\frac{3}{2},\ B=-5\).
\(\therefore I=\frac{3}{2}\int\frac{2x+6}{x^2+6x+5}\,dx-5\int\frac{dx}{x^2+6x+5}\).
The first integral \(=\frac{3}{2}\log|x^2+6x+5|\).
For the second, \(x^2+6x+5=(x+3)^2-2^2\), so \(\int\frac{dx}{(x+3)^2-2^2}=\frac{1}{4}\log\left|\frac{x+1}{x+5}\right|\).
\(\therefore I=\frac{3}{2}\log|x^2+6x+5|-\frac{5}{4}\log\left|\frac{x+1}{x+5}\right|+c\).

Write \(2x+1 = A(2x+4)+B\), where \(2x+4=\frac{d}{dx}(x^2+4x-5)\).
Comparing: \(2A=2,\ 4A+B=1\Rightarrow A=1,\ B=-3\).
\(\therefore I=\int\frac{2x+4}{x^2+4x-5}\,dx-3\int\frac{dx}{x^2+4x-5}\).
The first integral \(=\log|x^2+4x-5|\).
Now \(x^2+4x-5=(x+2)^2-3^2\), so \(\int\frac{dx}{(x+2)^2-3^2}=\frac{1}{6}\log\left|\frac{x-1}{x+5}\right|\).
\(\therefore I=\log|x^2+4x-5|-\frac{1}{2}\log\left|\frac{x-1}{x+5}\right|+c\).

Write \(2x+3 = A(4x+3)+B\), where \(4x+3=\frac{d}{dx}(2x^2+3x-1)\).
Comparing: \(4A=2,\ 3A+B=3\Rightarrow A=\frac{1}{2},\ B=\frac{3}{2}\).
\(\therefore I=\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{4x+3}{2x^2+3x-1}\,dx+\frac{3}{2}\int\frac{dx}{2x^2+3x-1}\).
The first integral \(=\frac{1}{2}\log|2x^2+3x-1|\).
For the second, \(2x^2+3x-1=2\left[\left(x+\frac{3}{4}\right)^2-\left(\frac{\sqrt{17}}{4}\right)^2\right]\), so
\(\int\frac{dx}{2x^2+3x-1}=\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{dx}{\left(x+\frac{3}{4}\right)^2-\left(\frac{\sqrt{17}}{4}\right)^2}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{17}}\log\left|\frac{4x+3-\sqrt{17}}{4x+3+\sqrt{17}}\right|\).
\(\therefore I=\frac{1}{2}\log|2x^2+3x-1|+\frac{3}{2\sqrt{17}}\log\left|\frac{4x+3-\sqrt{17}}{4x+3+\sqrt{17}}\right|+c\).

Write \(3x+4 = A(4x+2)+B\), where \(4x+2=\frac{d}{dx}(2x^2+2x+1)\).
Comparing: \(4A=3,\ 2A+B=4\Rightarrow A=\frac{3}{4},\ B=\frac{5}{2}\).
\(\therefore I=\frac{3}{4}\int\frac{4x+2}{\sqrt{2x^2+2x+1}}\,dx+\frac{5}{2}\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{2x^2+2x+1}}\).
The first integral \(=\frac{3}{4}\cdot 2\sqrt{2x^2+2x+1}=\frac{3}{2}\sqrt{2x^2+2x+1}\).
For the second, \(2x^2+2x+1=2\left[\left(x+\frac{1}{2}\right)^2+\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2\right]\), so
\(\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{2x^2+2x+1}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{\left(x+\frac{1}{2}\right)^2+\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\log\left|\left(x+\tfrac{1}{2}\right)+\sqrt{x^2+x+\tfrac{1}{2}}\right|\).
\(\therefore I=\frac{3}{2}\sqrt{2x^2+2x+1}+\frac{5}{2\sqrt{2}}\log\left|\left(x+\tfrac{1}{2}\right)+\sqrt{x^2+x+\tfrac{1}{2}}\right|+c\).

Write \(7x+3 = A(2-2x)+B\), where \(2-2x=\frac{d}{dx}(3+2x-x^2)\).
Comparing: \(-2A=7,\ 2A+B=3\Rightarrow A=-\frac{7}{2},\ B=10\).
\(\therefore I=-\frac{7}{2}\int\frac{2-2x}{\sqrt{3+2x-x^2}}\,dx+10\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{3+2x-x^2}}\).
The first integral \(=-\frac{7}{2}\cdot 2\sqrt{3+2x-x^2}=-7\sqrt{3+2x-x^2}\).
For the second, \(3+2x-x^2=2^2-(x-1)^2\), so \(\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{2^2-(x-1)^2}}=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x-1}{2}\right)\).
\(\therefore I=-7\sqrt{3+2x-x^2}+10\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{x-1}{2}\right)+c\).

First rationalise: \(\sqrt{\frac{x-7}{x-9}}=\frac{x-7}{\sqrt{(x-7)(x-9)}}=\frac{x-7}{\sqrt{x^2-16x+63}}\).
Write \(x-7 = A(2x-16)+B\), where \(2x-16=\frac{d}{dx}(x^2-16x+63)\).
Comparing: \(2A=1,\ -16A+B=-7\Rightarrow A=\frac{1}{2},\ B=1\).
\(\therefore I=\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{2x-16}{\sqrt{x^2-16x+63}}\,dx+\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x^2-16x+63}}\).
The first integral \(=\frac{1}{2}\cdot 2\sqrt{x^2-16x+63}=\sqrt{x^2-16x+63}\).
Now \(x^2-16x+63=(x-8)^2-1\), so \(\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{(x-8)^2-1}}=\log\left|(x-8)+\sqrt{x^2-16x+63}\right|\).
\(\therefore I=\sqrt{x^2-16x+63}+\log\left|(x-8)+\sqrt{x^2-16x+63}\right|+c\).

First rationalise: \(\sqrt{\frac{9-x}{x}}=\frac{9-x}{\sqrt{x(9-x)}}=\frac{9-x}{\sqrt{9x-x^2}}\).
Write \(9-x = A(9-2x)+B\), where \(9-2x=\frac{d}{dx}(9x-x^2)\).
Comparing: \(-2A=-1,\ 9A+B=9\Rightarrow A=\frac{1}{2},\ B=\frac{9}{2}\).
\(\therefore I=\frac{1}{2}\int\frac{9-2x}{\sqrt{9x-x^2}}\,dx+\frac{9}{2}\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{9x-x^2}}\).
The first integral \(=\frac{1}{2}\cdot 2\sqrt{9x-x^2}=\sqrt{9x-x^2}\).
Now \(9x-x^2=\left(\frac{9}{2}\right)^2-\left(x-\frac{9}{2}\right)^2\), so \(\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{\left(\frac{9}{2}\right)^2-\left(x-\frac{9}{2}\right)^2}}=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{2x-9}{9}\right)\).
\(\therefore I=\sqrt{9x-x^2}+\frac{9}{2}\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{2x-9}{9}\right)+c\).

Put \(t=\sin x\), so \(dt=\cos x\,dx\).
\(\therefore I=\int\frac{3\,dt}{4t^2+4t-1}\).
Now \(4t^2+4t-1=4\left(t+\frac{1}{2}\right)^2-2=4\left[\left(t+\frac{1}{2}\right)^2-\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\right)^2\right]\).
\(\therefore I=\frac{3}{4}\int\frac{dt}{\left(t+\frac{1}{2}\right)^2-\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\right)^2}=\frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{2\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt2}}\log\left|\frac{t+\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{\sqrt2}}{t+\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{\sqrt2}}\right|\).
Restoring \(t=\sin x\):
\(\therefore I=\frac{3\sqrt2}{8}\log\left|\frac{2\sin x+1-\sqrt2}{2\sin x+1+\sqrt2}\right|+c\).

Simplify the integrand: \(\frac{e^{3x}-e^{2x}}{e^x+1}=\frac{e^{2x}(e^x-1)}{e^x+1}\), so \(\sqrt{\frac{e^{3x}-e^{2x}}{e^x+1}}=e^x\sqrt{\frac{e^x-1}{e^x+1}}\).
Put \(t=e^x\), so \(dt=e^x\,dx\).
\(\therefore I=\int\sqrt{\frac{t-1}{t+1}}\,dt=\int\frac{t-1}{\sqrt{t^2-1}}\,dt=\int\frac{t}{\sqrt{t^2-1}}\,dt-\int\frac{dt}{\sqrt{t^2-1}}\).
\(=\sqrt{t^2-1}-\log\left|t+\sqrt{t^2-1}\right|\).
Restoring \(t=e^x\):
\(\therefore I=\sqrt{e^{2x}-1}-\log\left|e^x+\sqrt{e^{2x}-1}\right|+c\).
